description: Update all StudyInAustralia components to Canada design system and create guide pages. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 but follows the identical pattern. Migrate StudyInAustraliaHero from video-based to image-based hero, update UniversityCarousel to 3D arc, modernize all remaining components, and create guide pages.
steps: 1. Update components/StudyInAustralia/StudyInAustraliaHero.jsx: Replace video background with static image background using /images/hero/study-in-australia.webp (create if needed). Follow components/StudyInIreland/StudyInIrelandHero.jsx structure with gradient overlay, centered heading, two CTAs at bottom (consultation + WhatsApp with Australian context), remove stats array, use framer-motion animations.

2. Update components/StudyInAustralia/UniversityCarousel.jsx: Replace current implementation with Canada's custom 3D arc carousel from components/StudyInCanada/UniversityCarousel.jsx. Keep existing Australia university data but apply 3D arc transform logic, touch/mouse drag, autoplay, matching visual styling.

3. Update components/StudyInAustralia/OnlineDegreeSection.jsx: Follow components/StudyInIreland/OnlineDegreeSection.jsx pattern with guide links section (5 guides: study-in-australia, cost-of-studying, living-and-culture, scholarships, post-study-work-visa), modern card layout, consistent color scheme.
4. Update components/StudyInAustralia/WhatItGetsYou.jsx: Match components/StudyInIreland/WhatItGetsYou.jsx layout and styling with Australia-specific benefits content.
7. Update components/StudyInAustralia/CostOfStudyingAustralia.jsx: Follow components/StudyInIreland/CostOfStudyingIreland.jsx structure with Australia tuition and living cost data.

10. Create app/study-in-australia/[guide]/page.js: Create dynamic route page following app/study-in-ireland/[guide]/page.js structure. Include 5 guides in AUSTRALIA_GUIDES object with Australia-specific content: 'study-in-australia', 'cost-of-studying', 'living-and-culture', 'scholarships', 'post-study-work-visa'. Each guide with id, vol, slug, title, shortTitle, badge, tagline, heroImage (use Australian university images), pillColors, and markdown content tailored to studying in Australia.
